limitations: Only explicitly selected local roots are profiled; archive completeness, rights and provider context require answers.

Skipped counts include encountered excluded filesystem entries; hidden subtrees are not traversed and their file counts are unknown. Credential exclusions use known filename patterns, not a complete secret or privacy audit.
No networking, OCR, native CAD or legacy Office extraction; unsupported files remain inventory only.
Known format extensions are counted separately; arbitrary or absent filename suffixes are grouped as other in shared inventory to avoid disclosing identifiers. Exact suffixes remain private.
Text is a bounded sample. Words and characters are measured; tokens, cases and workflow completion are not inferred.
Language is a model inference on document text samples; normalized model scores are not statistical confidence, mixed-language proportions or full-archive estimates.
CSV/XLSX first non-empty rows are treated as headers. Worksheet dimensions are declared metadata, not populated row totals; XLSX formulas use cached values only.
DOCX extraction covers the main document only; headers, footers, comments, images and embedded objects are not extracted.
EML extracts one preferred body, excludes attachments, and hashes message references privately; references do not establish complete cases.
Parser deadlines start after source reading; ordinary filesystem/storage operations have no wall-clock read deadline. Non-regular replacements are opened without blocking and rejected.
This local scanner does not anonymize content or guarantee offline isolation of the host model or application.

questions.prompt: What rights and permissions allow you to share this selected data with The General Data Company?
questions.reason: Rights are provider-declared; local files cannot establish permission.

questions.prompt: How does this selected scope relate to your full archive, and which parts are excluded?
questions.reason: Selected roots do not prove archive completeness.

questions.prompt: What industry, business function and organization produced this data?
questions.reason: Business context needs an explicit provider statement.

questions.prompt: What period does the content cover, and how much historical data is retained?
questions.reason: Filesystem modification times are not content dates.

questions.prompt: Which source systems and export processes produced these files?
questions.reason: File formats do not establish the source systems.

questions.prompt: How should records, messages and documents be linked to real cases or workflows?
questions.reason: Rows and files are not cases; joins require an explicit mapping.

questions.prompt: Which stages, decisions and verified outcomes are recorded for each workflow?
questions.reason: Textual status values cannot prove workflow completion.

questions.prompt: How frequently is this data updated, and can new exports be provided?
questions.reason: Local inventory cannot establish future availability.

questions.prompt: What personal or confidential information is present, and which anonymization rules are required?
questions.reason: Profiling is not a privacy audit or anonymization.
